actual_scope: Classify every optimal one-bit public header for branch-dependent raw broadcasts on n independent uniform mate pairs; prove a sharp one-unit gap and closed-form counts.
scope_change_reason: This is an abstract decoder-interface side theorem extending Jerry Chen PR912 beyond two pairs under the explicitly narrower raw-broadcast alphabet. It is a written proof, not a proof-assistant formalization or selected-caller admission.
bottleneck_link: Determines whether changing only raw payload selection can enlarge the optimal paid-header class. It cannot, so a broader search must change payload functions or the stated contract.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved new classification and completed three-pair corroboration; do not extend the payload alphabet.
